textes.anglais: With the destruction of Planet Vegeta forty-one years ago, the proud Saiyan race was believed to have vanished forever. However, on a barren frontier planet, a lone Saiyan known as "BROLY" has survived, raised in exile by his father Paragus. Recruited by the Frieza Force, he arrives on Earth to face Goku and Vegeta. As his rage grows, his power awakens beyond every limit, and the clash of the three Saiyans begins to shake the very foundations of the universe itself...
